newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee static against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee static against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was static against the dollar and marginally weaker against the pound on Friday, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial bank mean rate of 19.925 against the dollar from 19.925 on Thursday. The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 33.374 to a pound from 33.364 on Thursday.
"The market is very thin and it is trading in a narrow range thus reflecting no big activity in the inter-bank forex market," said one forex dealer.
"The market is still long for the moment after the frequent interventions of the central bank over the past weeks," the dealer added.
